items.title: The designate message cannot be signed straight from the command output
items.description: The owner flow prints a designation message that I must sign and give back to the designate step. When I sign exactly what the command printed, designate says the signature is not valid. Make what the command prints directly signable.
acceptance_criteria: The bytes written to stdout are the designation message that designate verifies.
A signature over the printed output is accepted by designate.
